profile.name: Kidus Asnake
profile.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer & Cloud Architect
profile.headline: Building high-performance web systems, cloud architectures & elegant digital products.
profile.bio: Full-stack engineer with 6+ years of expertise spanning Next.js, TypeScript, distributed microservices, and multi-cloud architectures. Passionate about performant developer tools, accessible UI design, and cloud-native solutions.
profile.location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia (Open to Remote / Global)

projects.title: OmniFlow AI - Intelligent Agent Orchestrator
projects.description: Enterprise-grade autonomous workflow engine with multi-model LLM chaining, visual DAG pipeline builder, and sub-second execution runtime.
projects.longDescription: Built for high-throughput workflow execution, OmniFlow enables enterprise teams to construct and monitor real-time AI agent graphs. Includes automatic retry pipelines, telemetry exports to OpenTelemetry, and token-cost optimization algorithms.

projects.title: PulseCloud - Serverless Infrastructure Telemetry
projects.description: High-velocity observability dashboard streaming real-time Kubernetes cluster health, memory pressure alerts, and distributed request traces.
projects.longDescription: Processes real-time telemetry from thousands of container nodes using WebSocket streams and WebGL charting. Achieved 60fps rendering under 100k data points/sec with zero browser stutter.

projects.title: AuraDB - Distributed Vector Memory Engine
projects.description: Ultra-lightweight vector search and embedding cache built for local and edge inference with HNSW indexing and quantization support.
projects.longDescription: A zero-dependency vector engine engineered for fast nearest-neighbor retrieval. Benchmarked at 99.4% recall on SIFT1M dataset while reducing memory footprint by 45%.

projects.title: Nebula UI - Accessible Headless Component System
projects.description: WCAG 2.1 AAA compliant design system featuring polymorphic React primitives, fluid token-based themes, and zero-runtime CSS support.
projects.longDescription: Created to bridge enterprise design consistency and engineering performance. Adopted across 12 product teams and battle-tested with full keyboard navigation and screen-reader tree coverage.

projects.title: Synthetix Settlement - Multi-Chain Liquidity Bridge
projects.description: Cryptographically verified settlement layer enabling zero-slippage cross-chain swaps with automated rebalancing and zk-proof verification.
projects.longDescription: Engineered smart contracts and Next.js DApp interface supporting EVM and non-EVM chains. Integrated gas estimation heuristics and simulated transaction previews for enhanced user safety.

projects.title: DevPulse - Engineering Velocity & Metrics Suite
projects.description: Data analytics suite parsing GitHub PR cycle times, code review bottlenecks, and deployment frequencies based on DORA metrics.
projects.longDescription: Integrates directly with Git providers to compute lead time for changes, deployment frequency, and mean time to recovery with actionable team insights.
